name: submit_plan
title: Submit Plan
description: Records the write operations you intend to make (create_*, update_*, delete_*, add_*, remove_*, set_*, apply_*, fix_*, activate_*, rename_*, reorder_*, call_method) and returns a planId. Write tools on this server are rejected until the plan is approved with approve_plan, and each write must match one plan entry's tool and args exactly. Use before any write, then present the returned plan to the user for approval.

summary.description: Plain-English summary of what will happen and why.

changes.description: Ordered list of every mutating tool call you intend to make.

args.description: Exact args object that will be passed to the tool

name: approve_plan
title: Approve Plan
description: Approves a submitted plan so its writes can run, for ttlMinutes (default 15). Use after the user has explicitly approved the plan.

name: get_current_plan
title: Get Current Plan
description: Inspect the current plan's status, approved changes, and which ones have been consumed. Useful for recovering mid-execution.

name: create_record
title: Create Record
description: Creates a record in any DocType using the signed-in user's permissions. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

name: update_record
title: Update Record
description: Updates fields on an existing record in any DocType using the signed-in user's permissions. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

name: get_record
title: Get Record
description: Returns one record from any DocType by name, as the signed-in user, including its child tables.

name: query_records
title: Query Records
description: Returns a list of records from any DocType, filtered and limited, as the signed-in user. Use to look up records; at most 200 rows come back.

name: delete_record
title: Delete Record
description: Deletes one record from any DocType using the signed-in user's permissions. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

name: search_memory
title: Search Memory
description: Semantic search over this site's saved reference notes: Frappe sandbox facts, working code patterns, past bug fixes, site context and handoff notes. Returns the best matches with id, topic, title, content and a similarity score. Use it to look up what the site has already learned before writing a script, debugging an error or creating a document. Notes are shared by all users of the site, and reading them requires the System Manager role.

query.description: Natural-language description of what to look up: the task or the symptom, not a file name.

topK.description: How many results to return (default 5, max 20).

topic.description: Optional filter to one category. Omit to search everything.

name: add_memory
title: Add Memory
description: Saves a note (topic, title, content) so that search_memory can find it later. Use it for a newly found sandbox restriction, a fix, a working code recipe or a fact about the site. The note is stored once for the whole site. It is ERPSmith's own note-keeping, not a change to an ERPNext record, so it needs no plan approval. Requires the System Manager role.

title.description: Short, specific, searchable heading (up to 140 characters).

content.description: Markdown body (up to 20,000 characters). Concise and specific.

name: update_memory
title: Update Memory
description: Edits an existing note by id (from search_memory or list_memory) and re-embeds it so search keeps finding it. Pass a new title, new content, or both. Requires the System Manager role.

id.description: The note id from search_memory or list_memory.

content.description: New body (optional if only the title changes).

name: delete_memory
title: Delete Memory
description: Deletes a note by id (from search_memory or list_memory). Use it for notes that are stale or wrong. Requires the System Manager role.

name: list_memory
title: List Memory
description: Lists saved notes (id, topic, title, created date), newest first, without semantic search. Use it to audit what is stored or to find an id to update or delete. Requires the System Manager role.

name: dump_memory
title: Dump Memory
description: Returns every saved note as one markdown document grouped by topic, for backup, review or committing to git. The text comes back in the response; nothing is written on the server. Requires the System Manager role.

name: search_erpnext_knowledge
title: Search ERPNext Knowledge
description: Semantic search over two sources built for this site: the structure of every DocType on the site (fields, types, required flags, child tables, what each links to and what links to it, custom fields and custom apps included) and the ERPNext user manual. Returns the best matches with kind, title, source, content and a similarity score. Use it to learn which DocType holds what, how documents flow or how a feature is set up. The index is built in the background after install or migrate. Requires the System Manager role.

query.description: What to look up, in natural language: a feature, a process, a DocType or a field.

topK.description: How many results to return (default 5, max 20).

kind.description: doctype = this site's DocType structure; manual = ERPNext user-manual pages ('doc' means the same). Omit to search both.

name: create_doctype
title: Create DocType
description: Creates a new custom DocType (stored in the database, custom=1) with its fields, naming rule and permissions; System Manager gets full access. Use for a new kind of document; add_field extends an existing DocType instead. It changes the database schema, which commits at once. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

module.description: Module Def it belongs to, e.g. Custom, CRM, Buying

fieldname.description: Derived from the label when omitted

options.description: Link: the linked DocType. Select: one option per line. Table: the child DocType.

inFilter.description: Show as a standard filter in the list view

isSubmittable.description: Documents can be submitted and cancelled, like invoices

isChild.description: A child table DocType, used inside another DocType

isSingle.description: A single record, like a Settings page

namingSeries.description: Naming series pattern, e.g. CF-.YYYY.-.##### (default CUSTOM-.YYYY.-.#####)

autoName.description: Frappe autoname rule, e.g. naming_series:, field:title or hash

name: get_doctype
title: Get DocType
description: Returns a DocType's settings, every field (custom fields and property overrides included) and the permission rules in force. Use before changing a DocType or writing code against its fields.

name: list_doctypes
title: List DocTypes
description: Lists DocTypes by name, optionally filtered by module or by a fragment of the name, showing whether each is custom, a child table, single or submittable. At most 200 come back.

name: delete_doctype
title: Delete DocType
description: Deletes a custom DocType (custom=1) with its custom fields, property setters and permission rules; standard DocTypes are refused. Frappe keeps the database table and its rows until bench trim-database drops them. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

name: rename_doctype
title: Rename DocType
description: Renames a custom DocType (custom=1) and its database table, updating links to it; standard DocTypes are refused. It changes the database schema, which commits at once. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

name: add_field
title: Add Field
description: Adds a field to a DocType. On a standard DocType it creates a Custom Field, the upgrade-safe layer Customize Form uses; on a custom DocType it adds the field to the DocType itself. It changes the database schema, which commits at once. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

fieldname.description: Derived from the label when omitted

fieldtype.description: Frappe fieldtype, e.g. Data, Int, Link, Select, Check, Date

options.description: Link: the linked DocType. Select: one option per line. Table: the child DocType.

inFilter.description: Show as a standard filter in the list view

insertAfter.description: Fieldname to place the new field after (default: the last field)

name: update_field
title: Update Field
description: Changes properties of an existing field (label, reqd, hidden, default, options, depends_on and so on). A Custom Field is edited directly, a field of a custom DocType is edited in the DocType, and a standard field gets Property Setters. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

updates.description: DocField property names and their new values

name: remove_field
title: Remove Field
description: Removes a Custom Field, or a field of a custom DocType. A standard DocType's own fields are refused; hiding one with set_property is the upgrade-safe alternative. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

name: list_fields
title: List Fields
description: Lists every field of a DocType in form order, custom fields included, with type, options, required, hidden and default. Use to find fieldnames before writing code or changing fields.

name: reorder_fields
title: Reorder Fields
description: Changes the form order of a DocType's fields with a field_order Property Setter, as Customize Form does. The listed fields come first in the given order and the rest keep their order after them. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

name: set_property
title: Set Property
description: Overrides one property of a DocType or of one of its fields with a Property Setter, without editing the DocType. Use for hidden, reqd, default, read_only, options or in_list_view on standard DocTypes. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

property.description: A DocField property (for a field) or DocType property, e.g. reqd, hidden, default

name: create_client_script
title: Create Client Script
description: Creates a Client Script: JavaScript that runs in the browser on a DocType's form or list view, e.g. frappe.ui.form.on('DocType', { field_name(frm) { frm.set_value(...) } }). Use to auto-fill, validate, show or hide fields on the form. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

name: update_client_script
title: Update Client Script
description: Replaces a Client Script's code, or enables or disables it. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.

name: list_client_scripts
title: List Client Scripts
description: Lists Client Scripts with their DocType, view and enabled state, optionally for one DocType. At most 100 come back, newest first.

name: get_client_script
title: Get Client Script
description: Returns a Client Script's full JavaScript with its DocType, view and enabled state. Use before changing or debugging it.

name: create_server_script
title: Create Server Script
description: Creates a Server Script: Python run by Frappe's sandbox on a DocType event, as an API method at /api/method/<apiMethod>, on a schedule, or as a permission query. The script is checked against the sandbox's limits before it is saved, and each problem comes back with a working replacement. Needs server scripts enabled on the bench and an approved plan from submit_plan.

doctype.description: The DocType, for DocType Event and Permission Query

apiMethod.description: For API: the method name, served at /api/method/<apiMethod>

cronExpression.description: For Scheduler Event: how often it runs (default Hourly)

script.description: Python code. frappe and json are available; DocType Event scripts get doc.

name: update_server_script
title: Update Server Script
description: Replaces a Server Script's code (checked against the sandbox's limits first), changes its DocType event, or enables or disables it. Needs server scripts enabled on the bench and an approved plan from submit_plan.

name: list_server_scripts
title: List Server Scripts
description: Lists Server Scripts with their type, DocType, event, API method, schedule and enabled state, optionally filtered by DocType or script type. At most 100 come back, newest first.

name: get_server_script
title: Get Server Script
description: Returns a Server Script's full Python code with its type, DocType, event, API method, schedule and enabled state. Use before changing or debugging it.

name: apply_script_fix
title: Apply Script Fix
description: Replaces the code of a Client Script or Server Script with a corrected version and, by default, enables it. Server-side code is checked against the sandbox's limits first. Use after debug_client_script or debug_server_script. Needs an approved plan from submit_plan.
